chunks: 2329 - He said: And I asked him about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
"And whoever intends therein deviation through wrongdoing, We will make him taste a painful punishment."
He said: "Every ظلم is ilḥād, and striking a servant without any fault is among that ilḥād."

key_terms.الْإِلْحَادِ: the condemned deviation referred to in the verse
key_terms.بِإِلْحَادٍ: deviation from what is right, here understood as wrongful transgression
key_terms.ظُلْمٍ: injustice or oppression in any form

ai.seo_question: What does ilhad by wrongdoing mean in Qur'an 22:25 according to Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the Qur'anic phrase about ilhad in the Sacred Precinct by broadening it to include every form of injustice. It emphasizes that oppression, even in ordinary social dealings such as beating a servant without cause, falls under blameworthy deviation and incurs grave moral responsibility.
